_meta.method: Move names come from three sources: name_source=metadata (verbatim from framedata_meta.lua, AUTHORITATIVE); name_source=baston (active-box geometry cross-matched pixel/sequence-exact to a unique ROM pointer against Baston ESN3S, AUTHORITATIVE for st.MP/LK/MK which the meta does not annotate); name_source=inferred (timing/geometry guess, a fallback). Box geometry + timing remain ROM-verified in all cases.

CROUCH_LIGHT_PUNCH.rationale: framedata_meta.lua GOUKI: "1d28e" -- Cr LP  (meta typo; 1d28 is the present pointer)

CROUCH_MEDIUM_PUNCH.rationale: framedata_meta.lua does not annotate Cr MP. Inferred from ROM-pointer position (1d28 Cr LP < 1dd8 < 1e88 < 1f68 Cr LK -> the two punch slots before the kicks) + a medium-size active box (22f, active 5-8). Box geometry remains ROM-verified; only the name is inferred.

CROUCH_HEAVY_PUNCH.rationale: framedata_meta.lua does not annotate Cr HP. Inferred from ROM-pointer position (between Cr LP 1d28 and Cr LK 1f68) + a heavier/longer active box (35f, active 5-9). Box geometry remains ROM-verified; only the name is inferred.

CROUCH_MEDIUM_KICK.rationale: framedata_meta.lua GOUKI: "2008" -- Cr MK  (corrects prior guess 2008/CrHK)

CROUCH_HEAVY_KICK.rationale: framedata_meta.lua GOUKI: "20d8" -- Cr HK  (corrects prior guess 2008)

HEAVY_PUNCH.rationale: framedata_meta.lua GOUKI: Target HP "3850" is a proxy to "1818", i.e. 1818 = HP  (corrects prior guess 1e88)

HEAVY_KICK.rationale: framedata_meta.lua GOUKI: "1b08" -- Close HK  (corrects prior guess 1818, which is HP)

MEDIUM_PUNCH.rationale: Baston ESN3S 'Strong' (fd_normals/002) active box [-56,24,18,48] -> PyKuma (32,-66,24,18): pixel-exact, unique match to 14e8 (active=4). Not in framedata_meta.lua.

LIGHT_KICK.rationale: Baston ESN3S 'Short' (fd_normals/014) active box [-72,38,10,14] -> PyKuma (34,-24,38,10): pixel-exact, unique match to 1908 (active=4). Not in framedata_meta.lua.

MEDIUM_KICK.rationale: Baston ESN3S 'Forward' (fd_normals/015) active-box sequence [(36,-78,24,20)+(28,-62,18,14) then (36,-72,20,16)]: frame-by-frame unique match to 1988 (active=5). Corrects prior guess 1dd8. Not in framedata_meta.lua.

GOSHORYUKEN:light.rationale: Baston ESN3S 'Gou Shoryuken (Jab)' startup 3 / active 14 == ROM 84f8 (su 3, boxes 4-17, one hit_frames window); ROM movement rises 56px and returns to ground within the script. Pointer order 84f8 < 85c8 < 8658 matches LP < MP < HP everywhere else.

GOSHORYUKEN:medium.rationale: Baston 'Gou Shoryuken (Strong)' startup 2 / active 7 == ROM 85c8 (su 2, boxes 3-9, hit_frames = 2 hits); ROM movement rises 87px and the script ends mid-air (fall = separate script).

GOSHORYUKEN:heavy.rationale: Baston 'Gou Shoryuken (Fierce)' startup 1 / active 23 == ROM 8658 (su 1, boxes 2-24, hit_frames = 3 hits); ROM movement rises 124px, script ends mid-air.

TATSUMAKI:light.rationale: Baston 'Tatsumaki Zankuu Kyaku (Short)' startup 11 / active 4 == ROM 86e8 (su 11, hit windows 12-13 + 15-16); symmetric spin boxes (-64..+76) and 92px forward travel.

TATSUMAKI:medium.rationale: Baston 'Tatsumaki Zankuu Kyaku (Forward)' startup 2 / active 10 == ROM 87f8 (su 2, 5 two-frame hit windows); 130px travel.

TATSUMAKI:heavy.rationale: Baston 'Tatsumaki Zankuu Kyaku (RH)' startup 2 / active 18 == ROM 8968 (su 2, 9 two-frame hit windows); 173px travel.

TATSUMAKI:air_light.rationale: Baston 'Air Tatsumaki Zankuu Kyaku (Short)' startup 5 / active 3 == ROM 9618 (su 5, windows 6-7 + 10); ROM movement descends (airborne script).

TATSUMAKI:air_medium.rationale: Baston 'Air Tatsumaki (Forward)' startup 5 / active 6 == ROM 9738 (su 5, 4 windows); descends.

TATSUMAKI:air_heavy.rationale: Baston 'Air Tatsumaki (RH)' startup 5 / active 12 == ROM 9818 (su 5, 6 windows); descends.
